unit:root.title: Tokenizer and word-count modules with explicit contract
unit:root.objective: Own the boundary between the tokenizer and word-count modules and prove the contract holds.

outcomes.statement: tokenizer.js and word-count.js work together through the tokenize contract, each independently tested.

criteria.statement: Two independent modules exist with an explicit contract: tokenizer.js exports tokenize(text), word-count.js imports it and exports countWords(text), each with its own node:test file, without modifying stage8-probe.js.

expectedBenefits: Each module is validated on its own with its own node:test file.
expectedCosts: The tokenize(text) contract must stay stable for word-count.js to rely on it.

integration.objective: Compose the tokenizer and word-count changes and prove the tokenize contract holds end to end.

unit:tokenizer.title: Tokenizer module
unit:tokenizer.objective: Implement src/tokenizer.js exporting tokenize(text), returning lowercase words without punctuation.

outcomes.statement: tokenize(text) returns an array of lowercase, punctuation-free words.

criteria.statement: tokenizer.js exports tokenize(text) returning an array of lowercase words with punctuation stripped, verified by its own node:test file.

unit:word-count.title: Word-count module
unit:word-count.objective: Implement src/word-count.js exporting countWords(text), importing tokenize from tokenizer.js and returning a word-frequency object.

outcomes.statement: countWords(text) returns an object mapping each tokenized word to its frequency.

criteria.statement: word-count.js imports tokenize from tokenizer.js and exports countWords(text) returning word-frequency counts, verified by its own node:test file.

seam:tokenize-contract.specification: tokenizer.js exports tokenize(text: string): string[], returning lowercase words with punctuation stripped.

rules: tokenize(text) always returns an array of lowercase words with punctuation removed.
